title: Spectral bipartiteness in generalized odd graphs of diameter three
summary: For a graph $G$ of order $n$, put $σ(G)=(λ_1(G)+λ_n(G))/n$. We determine the first three largest values of this invariant among nonbipartite distance-regular graphs of diameter three and odd girth at least seven. The unique maximizer is the folded $7$-cube, with value $1/32$; the unique second maximizer is the Odd graph $O_4$, with value $1/35$; and the unique third maximizer is $C_7$, with value $2(1-\cos(π/7))/7$. More precisely, every other graph in the class satisfies $σ(G)<1/36$. This answers Problem~11 of Abiad, Taranchuk and van Veluw in \emph{Electronic Journal of Combinatorics}…
